description: Obtain information about one or more RDS snapshots. These can be for unclustered snapshots or snapshots of clustered DBs (Aurora).

parameters.name: access_key
parameters.description: AWS access key ID. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_ACCESS_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The aws_access_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_access_key_id alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: aws_ca_bundle
parameters.description: The location of a CA Bundle to use when validating SSL certificates. The AWS_CA_BUNDLE environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: aws_config
parameters.description: A dictionary to modify the botocore configuration. Parameters can be found in the AWS documentation https://botocore.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/reference/config.html#botocore.config.Config.

parameters.name: db_cluster_identifier
parameters.description: RDS cluster name for which to find snapshots. Mutually exclusive with db_snapshot_identifier, db_instance_identifier, db_cluster_snapshot_identifier.

parameters.name: db_cluster_snapshot_identifier
parameters.description: Name of an RDS cluster snapshot. Mutually exclusive with db_instance_identifier, db_snapshot_identifier, db_cluster_identifier.

parameters.name: db_instance_identifier
parameters.description: RDS instance name for which to find snapshots. Mutually exclusive with db_snapshot_identifier, db_cluster_identifier, db_cluster_snapshot_identifier.

parameters.name: db_snapshot_identifier
parameters.description: Name of an RDS (unclustered) snapshot. Mutually exclusive with db_instance_identifier, db_cluster_identifier, db_cluster_snapshot_identifier.

parameters.name: debug_botocore_endpoint_logs
parameters.description: Use a botocore.endpoint logger to parse the unique (rather than total) "resource:action" API calls made during a task, outputing the set to the resource_actions key in the task results. Use the aws_resource_action callback to output to total list made during a playbook. The ANSIBLE_DEBUG_BOTOCORE_LOGS environment variable may also be used. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: endpoint_url
parameters.description: URL to connect to instead of the default AWS endpoints. While this can be used to connection to other AWS-compatible services the amazon.aws and community.aws collections are only tested against AWS. The AWS_URL environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: A named AWS profile to use for authentication. See the AWS documentation for more information about named profiles https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-profiles.html. The AWS_PROFILE environment variable may also be used. The profile option is mutually exclusive with the aws_access_key, aws_secret_key and session_token options.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The AWS region to use. For global services such as IAM, Route53 and CloudFront, region is ignored. The AWS_REGION environment variable may also be used. See the Amazon AWS documentation for more information http://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#ec2_region.

parameters.name: secret_key
parameters.description: AWS secret access key. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY or AWS_SECRET_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The secret_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_secret_access_key alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: session_token
parameters.description: AWS STS session token for use with temporary credentials. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SESSION_TOKEN environment variable may also be used. The session_token and profile options are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: snapshot_type
parameters.description: Type of snapshot to find. By default both automated and manual snapshots will be returned. Choices: "automated" "manual" "shared" "public"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: When set to false, SSL certificates will not be validated for communication with the AWS APIs. Setting validate_certs=false is strongly discouraged, as an alternative, consider setting aws_ca_bundle instead. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Get information about an snapshot
  amazon.aws.rds_snapshot_info:
    db_snapshot_identifier: snapshot_name
  register: new_database_info

- name: Get all RDS snapshots for an RDS instance
  amazon.aws.rds_snapshot_info:
    db_instance_identifier: helloworld-rds-master

return_values.name: cluster_snapshots
return_values.description: List of cluster snapshots. Returned: When cluster parameters are passed.

return_values.name: allocated_storage
return_values.description: The allocated storage size in gibibytes (GiB). Returned: always Sample: 1

return_values.name: availability_zones
return_values.description: The list of Availability Zones (AZs) where instances in the DB cluster snapshot can be restored. Returned: always Sample: ["ca-central-1a", "ca-central-1b"]

return_values.name: cluster_create_time
return_values.description: The time when the DB cluster was created. Returned: always Sample: "2018-05-17T00:13:40.223000+00:00"

return_values.name: db_cluster_identifier
return_values.description: The DB cluster identifier of the DB cluster that this DB cluster snapshot was created from. Returned: always Sample: "test-aurora-cluster"

return_values.name: db_cluster_resource_id
return_values.description: The resource ID of the DB cluster that this DB cluster snapshot was created from. Returned: always Sample: "cluster-ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"

return_values.name: db_cluster_snapshot_arn
return_values.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the DB cluster snapshot.6 Returned: always Sample: "arn:aws:rds:ca-central-1:123456789012:cluster-snapshot:test-aurora-snapshot"

return_values.name: db_cluster_snapshot_identifier
return_values.description: The identifier for the DB cluster snapshot. Returned: always Sample: "test-aurora-snapshot"

return_values.name: engine
return_values.description: The name of the database engine for this DB cluster snapshot. Returned: always Sample: "aurora"

return_values.name: engine_mode
return_values.description: The engine mode of the database engine for this DB cluster snapshot. Returned: always Sample: "provisioned"

return_values.name: engine_version
return_values.description: The version of the database engine for this DB cluster snapshot. Returned: always Sample: "5.6.10a"

return_values.name: iam_database_authentication_enabled
return_values.description: Whether mapping of Amazon Web Services Identity and Access Management (IAM) accounts to database accounts is enabled. Returned: always Sample: false

return_values.name: kms_key_id
return_values.description: the Amazon Web Services KMS key identifier for the encrypted DB cluster snapshot. Returned: when storage_encrypted is true Sample: "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd1234-1234-aaaa-0000-1234567890ab"

return_values.name: license_model
return_values.description: The license model information for this DB cluster snapshot. Returned: always Sample: "aurora"

return_values.name: master_username
return_values.description: The master username for this DB cluster snapshot. Returned: always Sample: "shertel"

return_values.name: percent_progress
return_values.description: The percentage of the estimated data that has been transferred. Returned: always Sample: 0

return_values.name: port
return_values.description: The port that the DB cluster was listening on at the time of the snapshot. Returned: always Sample: 0

return_values.name: snapshot_create_time
return_values.description: The time when the snapshot was taken. Returned: always Sample: "2018-05-17T00:23:23.731000+00:00"

return_values.name: snapshot_type
return_values.description: The type of the DB cluster snapshot. Returned: always Sample: "manual"

return_values.name: status
return_values.description: The status of this DB cluster snapshot. Returned: always Sample: "creating"

return_values.name: storage_encrypted
return_values.description: Indicates whether the DB cluster snapshot is encrypted. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: tags
return_values.description: Tags of the snapshot. Returned: when snapshot is not shared.

return_values.name: vpc_id
return_values.description: The VPC ID associated with the DB cluster snapshot. Returned: always Sample: "vpc-abcd1234"

return_values.name: snapshots
return_values.description: List of non-clustered snapshots. Returned: When cluster parameters are not passed.

return_values.name: availability_zone
return_values.description: The name of the Availability Zone the DB instance was located in at the time of the DB snapshot. Returned: always Sample: "us-west-2b"

return_values.name: db_instance_identifier
return_values.description: The DB instance identifier of the DB instance this DB snapshot was created from. Returned: always Sample: "hello-world-rds"

return_values.name: db_snapshot_arn
return_values.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the DB snapshot. Returned: always Sample: "arn:aws:rds:us-west-2:123456789012:snapshot:rds:hello-world-rds-us1-2018-05-16-04-03"

return_values.name: db_snapshot_identifier
return_values.description: The identifier for the DB snapshot. Returned: always Sample: "rds:hello-world-rds-us1-2018-05-16-04-03"

return_values.name: dbi_resource_id
return_values.description: The identifier for the source DB instance, which can’t be changed and which is unique to an Amazon Web Services Region. Returned: always Sample: "db-ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"

return_values.name: dedicated_log_volume
return_values.description: Whether the DB instance has a dedicated log volume (DLV) enabled. Returned: always Sample: false

return_values.name: encrypted
return_values.description: Whether the DB snapshot is encrypted. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: instance_create_time
return_values.description: The time when the DB instance, from which the snapshot was taken, was created. Returned: always Sample: "2017-10-10T04:00:07.434000+00:00"

return_values.name: iops
return_values.description: The Provisioned IOPS (I/O operations per second) value of the DB instance at the time of the snapshot. Returned: always Sample: 3000

return_values.name: multi_tenant
return_values.description: Whether the snapshot is of a DB instance using the multi-tenant configuration (TRUE) or the single-tenant configuration (FALSE). Returned: always Sample: false

return_values.name: option_group_name
return_values.description: The option group name for the DB snapshot. Returned: always Sample: "default:postgres-9-5"

return_values.name: original_snapshot_create_time
return_values.description: The time of the CreateDBSnapshot operation. Doesn’t change when the snapshot is copied. Returned: always Sample: "2017-10-10T04:00:07.434000+00:00"

return_values.name: snapshot_target
return_values.description: Where manual snapshots are stored: Amazon Web Services Outposts or the Amazon Web Services Region. Returned: always Sample: "region"

return_values.name: storage_throughput
return_values.description: The storage throughput for the DB snapshot. Returned: always Sample: 500

return_values.name: storage_type
return_values.description: The storage type associated with DB snapshot. Returned: always Sample: "gp2"
